description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController class, which extends InventoryPDFController to generate PDF representations of sales orders, including header information, addresses, and other details.

classes.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class for generating Sales Order PDFs, extending InventoryPDFController with specific header and address building methods.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Builds the title for the PDF header, including the sales order number.

methods.name: getHeaderViewer
methods.description: Returns a header viewer object for the PDF.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnLeft
methods.description: Builds the left column of the header with quote information.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnCenter
methods.description: Builds the center column with subject, customer, contact, and purchase order details.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Builds the right column with issue date, due date, billing, and shipping addresses.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Returns the watermark content based on sales order status.
